countArray.description: One integer per countable group of individuals. Do not sum. A bare singular (koiras, naaras, nuori, …) with no number means 1.

maleIndividualCount.description: Males (koiras/uros). Bare singular → 1. koiraspukuinen is plumage, not male.

femaleIndividualCount.description: Females (naaras). Bare singular → 1. naaraspukuinen is plumage, not female.

movingStatus.description: Observation status codes. Allowed values: p — local, paikallinen; m — migrating, muuttava; kiert — wandering, kiertelevä; Ä — singing or territorial vocalization (heard); ä — vocalizing (heard); Än — seen singing; än — seen vocalizing.

birdPlumage.description: Single plumage string. If the observation contains multiple values, leave this as null. Allowed values: ad — adult, vanha; juv — juvenile, nuori; jp — juhlapukuinen; kpuk — koiraspukuinen; npuk — naaraspukuinen; pull — pullus, untuvikko; subad — esiaikuinen; null.
